story.title: WE MUST HELP EACH OTHER
paragraphs_en: Happiness is when everyone in the family helps .
I introduce my new friends to my mummy. I always listen to my mummy.
My grandmother helps me in pasting .
My father helps my mother in kitchen .
I help my brother in studies .
